description:
List the reports configured for automated recurring delivery on a property. Each item carries id, name, created_at, owner, period (week|month) and recipient_user_ids. This reflects the configured schedule (period + recipients) as stored. Cursor-paginated: pass the returned next_cursor back as cursor to page. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// list the property's scheduled/recurring reports.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: list_report_schedules
title: Scheduled reports
